# Findings that CodeQL reports today and that are not fixed yet. Each line is a rule id and a file.
# The CodeQL job fails for any finding that is not listed here, and warns about a line that no
# longer matches anything, so delete a line when its finding is fixed.

# plainText in the search adapter removes tags in one pass, so nested tags like <scr<b>ipt> leave a tag behind.
js/incomplete-multi-character-sanitization src/lib/tools/search.ts

# authSecret checks that the secret file exists and then reads or creates it, so two starting processes can race.
js/file-system-race src/lib/auth.ts

# The native build probe checks for an addon file and then creates it. It only runs in development and CI.
js/file-system-race scripts/qa/sandbox-native-build.mjs
